No model articulation or observed evidence that a certificate redemption was reused; the 'redeemed' field stays 0 and no redemptions occurred, so duplication of the same certificate for four points is neither articulated nor demonstrated.

The model did not claim the clerk reveals accepted inflated reports, and the transcript shows no clerk requests or public receipt data; therefore the meta-rule claim is neither articulated nor supported by the evidence.
